item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E006","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The government reported that a malaria-control plan was created for the Yanomami territory, including active case-finding and substantially increased testing, and stated that desintrusion creates conditions for restructuring health units and investing in sanitation.","notes":["Narrowed the causal wording from desintrusion being intended to enable these actions to the excerpt's statement that it creates conditions for them."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The federal government instituted the Mulher Viver sem Violência program through Decree 11.431 of 8 March 2023 to integrate and expand existing public services for women experiencing violence across health, public security, justice, social assistance, and financial-autonomy promotion, with implementation seeking humanized, comprehensive, non-revictimizing care.","notes":["Narrowed the attribution from Lula's government to the federal government because the excerpt does not name Lula."]}]}
